specification.outcome: Normal conversation can create an ordinary Backlog task or replace an unclaimed Backlog task specification without requiring a campaign or starting work.

scenarios.name: create an ordinary task
given: closed create request, writable verified board, current authority
when: host locks, revalidates, atomically journals invocation+intent+tombstones+event bytes, signs, publishes, observes
then: one task-created-from-request projects complete initial task
no campaign/readiness/work effect
receipt names exact event commit

scenarios.name: replace a complete backlog specification
given: closed specify request includes exact TaskId, complete replacement, exposed expectedTaskVersionDigest, target unclaimed Backlog
when: host validates expected version and publishes task-specified-from-request
then: only specification/digests change
other state preserved
unchanged replacement records invocation result but creates no operation IDs/event/commit

scenarios.name: reject ABA, identity, and authority races
given: operation binds repository/invocation/request/event/task version and authority snapshot
when: task changes, invocation bytes differ, identity bytes differ, signer/publisher authority changes, or history rewrites
then: defined conflict/read-only/uncertain result wins before further effect
unresolved state remains recoverable
stale/mismatched authority never publishes

scenarios.name: retry unrelated advancement
given: intent journal binds stable event bytes and attempts
then: host revalidates task and authority, appends abandoned attempt, returns intent-written, signs under new parent with same event bytes
same-task/identity changes conflict

scenarios.name: recover idempotently
given: invocation record is preflight, intent-written, commit-prepared, push-attempted, observed-published, receipt-recorded, or terminal-denied
then: same request bytes continues/returns stored terminal; different bytes conflict
uncertain push remains recoverable
every transition has sufficient durable attempt/terminal data

scenarios.name: route partial and combined intent safely
given: user asks create, partial edit, full replacement, or create-and-start
then: partial edit requires exposed complete spec+taskVersion and emits one complete specify request; unavailable/incomplete exposure denies
create-and-start waits for observed create receipt then issues distinct begin invocation; begin failure leaves created Backlog task and returns both results without rollback
campaign unchanged

scenarios.name: apply phase-specific failures
given: malformed input, invalid state/history, authority/journal/transport/signing failure, conflict, or uncertainty
then: phase and precedence select closed failure/receipt
publication absence proof governs terminal denial
authority never partial or duplicated

acceptanceCriteria: Validation is reject-only, not normalization. All specified lengths are JavaScript UTF-16 code units. Title and spec strings must already equal trim(); description is 0..10000 and not trim-validated. Accepted strings reject unpaired surrogates.

Closed request literals are create-task and specify-task. Create exact keys kind,title,description; title 1..200. Specify exact keys kind,taskId,expectedTaskVersionDigest,specification. Specification bounds: outcome 1..2000; scenarios 1..50; name 1..200; step arrays 1..50 entries 1..1000; criteria/exclusions 1..100 entries 1..2000; dependencies 0..100 entries 1..2000; mappings 1..100 paths 1..500; architecture 1..4000; canonical UTF-8 <=131072. Exact nested keys required. Pi owns raw JSON decoding; Tiber exact-validates resulting object.
Paths are slash-only relative literals: no leading slash, backslash, empty or '..' segment; '.' accepted; percent not decoded.

Canonical bytes are TextEncoder UTF-8 fixed-order JSON.stringify. Request order create kind,title,description; specify kind,taskId,expectedTaskVersionDigest,specification. Spec order outcome,scenarios,acceptanceCriteria,exclusions,dependencies,testMappings,architectureImplications; scenario name,given,when,then; arrays preserve order.

requestDigest = 'sha256:'+lowercase SHA-256(ASCII 'tiber-workflow-task-request-v1',0x00,canonical request JSON). specificationDigest preserves existing lowercase SHA-256(canonical spec JSON) without domain prefix. taskVersionDigest = 'sha256:'+lowercase SHA-256(ASCII 'tiber-task-version-v1',0x00,canonical JSON array of affecting event IDs).

Task-version-affecting event kinds exactly: task-created,task-campaign-goal-created,task-created-from-request,task-specified,task-specified-from-request,task-ready,task-claimed,task-claim-taken-over,task-increment-preserved,task-final-review-recorded,task-delivery-recorded,task-ci-recorded,task-review-opened,task-review-recorded,task-claim-released,task-completed. Order is verified linear single-parent commit ancestry then one event per commit. Merge/multi-parent history read-only.
TaskId lowercase canonical UUID v1..5 RFC variant. Generated operation/task/event IDs randomUUID v4; occurredAt canonical UTC ISO from injected clock; schemaVersion 1.

repositoryId is generated UUID in Git common directory bound to canonical realpath/remotes. invocationId = 'sha256:'+lowercase SHA-256(ASCII 'tiber-pi-invocation-v1',0,Pi persisted sessionId,0,toolCallId). Path aliases resolve repositoryId; binding mismatch denies.

Canonical task event file is events/<eventId>.json containing two-space pretty JSON plus newline, and each signed commit adds exactly that one previously absent path without other tree mutation. Commit subject is 'task: <kind> <taskId>', body 'Publish an append-only Tiber task event.', with configured Git author/committer and one parent except initial root. Observation verifies signature, parent rule, exact added path/tree diff, event parse/filename, and commit ancestry; event-containing boardHead is that commit OID.

Creation event fixed fields schemaVersion,eventId,kind,occurredAt,operationId,invocationId,requestDigest,task(id,title,description). Initial projection Backlog/unblocked, all Option evidence/claim/campaign fields none, increments empty, no Ready rank/priority; order linear commit ancestry.

Specification event fixed fields schemaVersion,eventId,kind,occurredAt,operationId,invocationId,requestDigest,taskId,expectedTaskVersionDigest,specificationDigest,specification. Projection validates exact expected version, unclaimed Backlog, canonical bytes/digests, unique identities.

Identity namespaces: taskId unique among task creations; eventId unique all events/paths; operationId unique request-origin events and retained operation records. Projection rejects duplicate history as read-only. Recovery scans singular historical identity; exact full bytes may reconcile matching journal, nonidentical bytes conflict locally while duplicate signed events themselves make board read-only. Historical bytes remain in append-only commits and retained journals.

Remote head must descend from last locally trusted head and complete root ancestry must be available and verified. Rewind/force-push, missing parent, shallow/incomplete history, merge/multi-parent commit, invalid signature/event/tree degrade board read-only. Before push this returns BOARD_READ_ONLY or CONFLICT if bound head changed incompatibly. After possibly-sent push inability to establish ancestry returns PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN and blocks more publication until observation resolves.

Invocation ledger is created after semantic request parsing and before board/effect work with repositoryId,invocationId,requestDigest,canonicalRequestBytes,state:preflight. Thus unchanged and state/authority denials are idempotent. Same invocation+same bytes returns/continues stored result; same invocation+different bytes always PUBLICATION_CONFLICT. Provider/schema rejection before execute creates no ledger and Pi guarantees toolCallId uniqueness.

Operation journal record fixed fields: schemaVersion,repositoryId,invocationId,operation,operationId Option,requestDigest,canonicalRequestBytes,eventId Option,taskId Option,expectedTaskVersionDigest Option,eventBytesBase64 Option,state,attempts,terminal Option,tombstonedIds. Option encoding is exactly {kind:'none'} or {kind:'some',value:...}. operation literals create-task|specify-task; states preflight|intent-written|commit-prepared|push-attempted|observed-published|receipt-recorded|terminal-denied.

Attempt schema fixed fields attemptNumber,parentRevision,commitRevision,preparedAt,pushDisposition,observedHead Option,absenceProof Option,abandoned. pushDisposition literals not-attempted|definitely-not-sent|unknown|sent. absenceProof is {kind:'local-no-push'} or {kind:'verified-remote-head',head}. terminal is {kind:'receipt',value:<closed receipt>} or {kind:'denial',value:<closed denial>}. Git revisions are lowercase 40..64 hex semantic values.

Ledger/journal transition is locked temp-write,file-fsync,rename,directory-fsync. preflight may terminal-deny or, with generated IDs and event bytes plus tombstones atomically, become intent-written. Success graph intent-written->commit-prepared->push-attempted->observed-published->receipt-recorded. Unrelated proven-absent advancement appends abandoned attempt and returns intent-written. terminal states idempotent. I/O leaves last durable state.

Recovery rule: exact same invocation/request/event bytes returns stored terminal even if board later changes; terminal result describes historical invocation. 'Conflict wins' applies only when invocation request bytes differ or unresolved operation's bound state/identity no longer matches. receipt recovery verifies establishing commit remains in current valid ancestry; otherwise board read-only/uncertain.

Before each signing and push, re-observe signer and publisher authority digest bound at preflight. Revocation/change before signing -> UNAUTHORIZED with local absence proof; after prepared but before push -> UNAUTHORIZED with local absence proof; during/after possibly-sent push -> PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN until observed.

Create-and-start: create receipt disposition published/reconciled must be observed before a new begin-task tool invocation. If create denied, begin is not requested. If begin denies, return create receipt plus begin denial; created task remains Backlog and is never rolled back.

Partial edit requires task detail exposure returning complete canonical specification, specificationDigest, taskVersionDigest, and verified boardHead. specify request carries expectedTaskVersionDigest. Missing/partial exposure returns TIBER_TASK_SPECIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE retry-after-state-change requiring complete-task-specification; version mismatch at submission returns PUBLICATION_CONFLICT.

Unchanged phase: invocation ledger -> local board/task/lifecycle/bytes -> lock -> fresh remote verify -> recompute lifecycle/version/bytes -> return unchanged terminal ledger. No operation IDs/event/commit/effect authority.

Pre-intent changed phase: ledger -> local board/task/lifecycle -> authority -> lock -> remote refresh -> collision/tombstone -> event construction -> locked revalidation -> atomic intent. Signing/push after intent. Post-intent terminal needs local no-push or verified remote absence/conflict; unknown remains recoverable.

Phase mapping: invalid signed projection/rewritten complete history BOARD_READ_ONLY. Remote fetch before intent PUBLICATION_FAILED. Fetch/observation after possibly-sent push PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN. Lock conflict PUBLICATION_CONFLICT. Missing/revoked authority PUBLICATION_UNAUTHORIZED unless push uncertain. Signing attempt SIGNING_FAILED. Definitely unsent transport PUBLICATION_FAILED.

Closed receipts: disposition literals published|reconciled|unchanged. Create receipt {code:'TIBER_TASK_CREATED',disposition:'published'|'reconciled',taskId,eventId:some,boardHead,specificationDigest:none}. Amend analogous code TIBER_TASK_SPECIFIED/eventId+digest some. Unchanged code TIBER_TASK_SPECIFICATION_UNCHANGED,disposition unchanged,eventId none,current digest some. Composite create-and-start returns {create:<receipt>,begin:<receipt-or-denial>}.

Closed denial {code,operation:'create-task'|'specify-task',taskId Option,retryability,requiredRecoveryEvidence}. Evidence literals: corrected-workflow-request,corrected-value,exact-task-id,corrected-specification,complete-task-specification,writable-signed-board,existing-task,unclaimed-backlog-task,configured-signing-and-publication-authority,repaired-journal,fresh-identifiers,retry-signing,retry-transport,fresh-verified-board,exact-remote-observation. boardHead is lowercase 40..64 hex.

Failure precedence create: WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID,TASK_VALUE_INVALID,TASK_BOARD_READ_ONLY,TASK_PUBLICATION_UNAUTHORIZED,TASK_PUBLICATION_FAILED prefetch,TASK_JOURNAL_IO,TASK_ID_COLLISION,TASK_SIGNING_FAILED,TASK_PUBLICATION_FAILED,TASK_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT,TASK_PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN. Amend inserts TASK_ID_INVALID,SPECIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE/SPECIFICATION_INVALID,TASK_NOT_FOUND,TASK_LIFECYCLE_INVALID,SPECIFICATION_UNCHANGED before changed authority. Retryability input errors retry-after-input; state/auth/conflict retry-after-state-change; journal/collision/signing/transport/uncertain transient.
Ordinary operations never promote, prioritize, review, claim, start, or alter campaign state.
specification.architectureImplications: Add closed create/specify requests, request-bound events, domain-separated request/task-version digests, canonical Unicode/bounds, linear history, and durable invocation/operation records. Host owns parsing, authority revalidation, lock, IDs, lifecycle/ABA checks, signed CAS publication, uncertainty observation, receipts; inference grants no authority/start.
